verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair question for a SaaS fraud-prevention platform, so the axis applies, but nothing in the evidence pack documents a Forter command-line tool. The pack shows REST APIs, webhooks, mobile and 3DS SDKs, and an official MCP server, but these are other capabilities and cannot be credited as a CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
